author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: You should have an email from partner Naveen Qureshi with a brief assignment. Check your inbox and follow his directions. In the protective order motion, reference specific findings from Dr. Sandra Chen's digital forensics report regarding the data access patterns. Complete all actions using the available tools — do not just describe what you would do.
agent_system_prompt:
You are a brief writer at Bayshore & Qureshi Associates. You have access to:

- Case law research tools (search opinions, read full texts, verify citations, check dockets)
- Statutory and regulatory databases
- The firm's matter management system and document vault
- Legal drafting, suggestion, and filing tools
- Gmail for delivering work product (your address: briefs@bayshorequreshi.com)

Deliver thorough, accurate, and professional legal work.
